title: Dune (Prime)
description: A portable native engine for Cryo’s Dune (1992, CD v3.7), available for Windows, macOS and Linux. Supply the original game files from your own CD; no original game content or mods are included.
creator: krismort

instructions.setup: Install the engine package for your operating system. On first launch, copy DUNE.DAT and DNCDPRG.EXE from your own Dune CD v3.7 into the folder shown by Dune Prime. On Debian/Ubuntu Linux, install SDL2 with sudo apt install libsdl2-2.0-0. Other Linux distributions also require SDL2.
instructions.controls: Use mouse and keyboard. F1 pauses and opens the session overlay; F1 or Escape resumes. Return Home ends the session.

engineReplacement.instructions: Supply DUNE.DAT and DNCDPRG.EXE from your own Dune CD v3.7. The first launch shows where to copy them. The original game content is not included. Linux requires SDL2.
